fusions.name: Corral the Stray
fusions.desc: Throws a heavy mesh over a straggler, dealing 30 damage to the first enemy it meets; when it lands, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Round Up
fusions.desc: Sweeps your mesh around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Under One Blanket
fusions.desc: Draws your allies in under a warm mesh: you and every ally within 4 tiles regain 14 health, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Woven Halter
fusions.desc: Conjures a woven halter of mesh: your critical chance rises by 3%, your critical hits deal 10% more, each kill returns 3 health and your maximum health rises by 12. Its effect increases by 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
